checks.name: manifest validates against bundle-manifest.schema.json
DATA_READY names the manifest hash and the WorldContentId
the directory is named by the WorldContentId
the Python verifier (the rules of worldbridge validate and the C# host) accepts it on a v1.4.8.119303 / v1.2.8.119303 host
inventory is sorted by UTF-8 bytes and unique
every inventory file exists with its size and SHA-256, and nothing else is in the bundle
totals match the inventory
the WorldContentId recomputes from the inventory
the manifest holds no absolute paths or timestamps
only source/, compiled/ and policies/ hold content
every bundle path is at most 120 bytes
compiled/ equals the MMR-26 terrain, MMR-27 id map and MMR-28 travel outputs compiled separately
source/ is the producer split byte for byte
policies/ are the repository policy files and the manifest names their hashes
compiled/compatibility.json (inside the WorldContentId) names the runtime lock's versions and the manifest's capabilities
engine versions are the runtime lock's
a bundle is sealed only for an ok travel graph, and the validation report says so
the producer lock hash is the repository lock's
the first publish created the bundle and a republish reused it unchanged
publication diagnostics (timings, absolute inputs) are written outside the bundle
worldbridge --inspect-bundle reports it valid with the same identity
the activation receipt schema accepts a complete U03 receipt and refuses a missing C07, another writer or a failed W03
the C# host verifier accepted the bundle and refused every tampering (tools/Test-WorldDataBundle.ps1)
